title: [CuTe, SM100] test_clc_fuzz fails after #2559 due to stale scheduler expectations
body:
## Summary

After #2559, `tests/cute/test_clc_fuzz.py` fails on SM100 because several scheduler-class assertions still reflect the scheduler dispatch behavior from before #2559.

At commit `c68c592fd9da1e40a4fb0b56229caae6754ac5c9`, the test result is:

```text
22 failed, 167 passed
```

## Representative failures:
```text
AssertionError: Expected SingleTileVarlenScheduler, got StaticPersistentTileScheduler

AssertionError: Expected SingleTileVarlenScheduler, got DynamicPersistentVarlenScheduler

AssertionError: Expected SingleTileScheduler fallback, got StaticPersistentTileScheduler
```
Current main (1cc7ff67cbc5685046c75183e8defecca3e35d5c) still contains the same assertions.
## Reproduction
On an SM100 GPU:
```
pytest -n=16 --tb=short tests/cute/test_clc_fuzz.py
```
Environment used for the observed failure:
GPU: GB200/B200, SM100
OS: Ubuntu 24.04, arm64
Python: 3.12.8
CUDA: 13.3
flash-attention: c68c592fd9da1e40a4fb0b56229caae6754ac5c9
nvidia-cutlass-dsl: 4.7

## Root cause
PR #2559 intentionally introduced new varlen scheduler dispatch behavior.
FlashAttentionForwardSm100 can now select:

1. `DynamicPersistentVarlenScheduler` when dynamic-persistent scheduler metadata is used;
2. `StaticPersistentTileScheduler` when the varlen workload is eligible for static persistence;
3. `SingleTileVarlenScheduler` otherwise.

However, the varlen helpers in `test_clc_fuzz.py` still unconditionally require SingleTileVarlenScheduler:
[check_varlen_output](https://github.com/Dao-AILab/flash-attention/blob/1cc7ff67cbc5685046c75183e8defecca3e35d5c/tests/cute/test_clc_fuzz.py#L305-L330)
[check_varlen_output_seqused](https://github.com/Dao-AILab/flash-attention/blob/1cc7ff67cbc5685046c75183e8defecca3e35d5c/tests/cute/test_clc_fuzz.py#L348-L377)
